caption: The video captures a small jungle waterfall tumbling over a sloping rock ledge into a murky green-brown pool, framed by dense tropical foliage. Four shirtless men in swim trunks are positioned around the wet rock face. One stands at the far-left edge, another stands on the upper ledge behind a third who sits with his legs extended down the cascade. A fourth man in patterned shorts stands mid-ledge facing the camera. Whitewater continuously rushes over the dark stone and the pool surface keeps churning with shifting foam. The seated man holds his position, making only small weight adjustments as the water flows around him. The far-left man and the upper-ledge man remain largely still. The mid-ledge man stays standing at the edge. The framing drifts slightly rightward, cropping the far-left man at the edge while shifting the right bank and open water within view.
relations: Whitewater flows continuously over the sloping rock ledge, feeding the churning pool below with shifting foam.
The seated man rests on the ledge with legs extended down the cascade, making only small weight adjustments.
Standing men remain on the far-left edge, upper ledge, and mid-ledge as water rushes around them.
The frame drifts rightward, cropping the far-left man while revealing more of the right bank and open water.
